25176939.source: CONFIRM-HF full text (PMC4359359, Table 2 + Results): 'Hospitalizations due to worsening HF ... 10 10 (7.6) ... 32 25 (19.4) ... 0.39 (0.19-0.82) ... 0.009' and 'Treatment with FCM was associated with a significant reduction in the risk of hospitalization due to worsening HF with a time-to-event analysis returning an HR of 0.39 with a 95% CI of (0.19-0.82) (P = 0.009)'. First-event (time-to-event) HR: 10 vs 25 patients with >=1 HF hospitalization.
25176939.verification: Verified against PMC4359359 Table 2 and Results text: HR 0.39 (0.19-0.82) reported directly. Crude RR from patient counts (10/~132 FCM vs 25/~129 placebo, denominators = analysis population per the 7.6%/19.4% rates) = 0.40, corroborating the HR. Abstract omits this isolated HF-hospitalisation effect (reports composite only), so it is a full-text recovery.
